verdict.rationale: Webhook docs describe events sent after balance, ownership, and transaction refreshes complete. This implies refreshes exist per data type and run asynchronously with completion notification. However, the pack never shows the API call that triggers an on-demand refresh. A community report of 'only daily pulls' suggests refresh frequency is limited, a caveat rather than a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a refresh-triggering API endpoint, documented refresh semantics (rate limits, frequency caps, data staleness), and independent hands-on confirmation of on-demand refresh.
